description: Consistance du réseau ferroviaire depuis 2003 is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Consistance du réseau ferroviaire de 2003 à 2013. "Lignes équipées de la radio sol-train": ce champ inclut également, depuis 2008, le GSM-R (Global System for Mobile communications – Railways), un standard de communication GSM adapté aux communications dans le secteur ferroviaire. "Lignes équipées de block automatique": dispositif de signalisation permettant d'espacer les trains. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Réseau. Its keywords are Réseau, Infrastructure, Sécurité & Qualité de Service Ferroviaire. The portal shows 2017-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
